description: Source code for a custom report in the ERPNext system, specifically for generating tax detail reports with filtering, sectioning, and data processing functionalities.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, fetch data, and optionally run a custom report section.

methods.name: run_report
methods.description: Applies custom report sections and filters to the data.

methods.name: filter_match
methods.description: Checks if a value matches a filter string, supporting various operators.

methods.name: doclist
methods.description: Creates list of document identifiers with abbreviations.

methods.name: as_split
methods.description: Splits fields with 'as' into tuples of original and alias.

methods.name: coalesce
methods.description: Generates SQL coalesce expressions for shared fields across doctypes.

methods.name: get_fieldstr
methods.description: Constructs SQL select fields string from field list.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for report display.

methods.name: modify_report_columns
methods.description: Adjusts column metadata based on doctype and field.

methods.name: modify_report_data
methods.description: Processes raw data, including tax line generation and amount adjustments.

methods.name: save_custom_report
methods.description: Saves or updates a custom report configuration.
